sourceBehavior.summary: The profile bounds the inactive-slot flow to hollywood build 50670960048600150 and the 17 ordered Quest 2 partitions. The pinned source comment says the Quest 2 ionstack binary is missing even though generated hash manifests and the deployment name it; this record preserves that source/deployment conflict and does not treat the flow as independently reproducible.

muraPolicy.writeBoundary: Live use is unavailable. The pinned source tree lacks the claimed Quest 2 ionstack payload, and Mura has no hardware reproduction, protected-state closure, or stock recovery. Source activation/reset confirmations, rollback readback, fastboot-restore readback, and machine-observed mark-success are also absent.

confirmations.prompt: Type root hollywood. The required Quest 2 ionstack binary is missing from the pinned source tree, so this disabled parity record cannot execute.
Type overwrite followed by the observed inactive suffix. Interruption can make that slot unbootable.
Type unlock 16476800118700000. The unlock erases userdata, misc and metadata.

value.value: Stop and preserve the untouched slot and backup. The source/deployment conflict must be resolved before any write.
At least one stock slot remains bootable or USB Update Mode remains reachable.
